wren_greet: Oh! You're awake! We found you asleep in the meadow with starlight still clinging to your hair.
This is Starfall Haven. Ever since the star broke over the hills, pieces of the land have been drifting up into the sky.
Those floating isles? They were fields and orchards once. Now only the wind can reach them.
wren_idle: When the wind sings around the isles, it means the star is dreaming.
Mira's stall smells of moonmint today. You should visit her.
If you ever get lost, look for the light of the Starspire. It always points home.
wings_offer: See the columns of swirling wind? Updrafts. Step inside one, jump, and jump again to spread your wings.
There's a little isle just north of town. Ride its updraft and land on top. Show me you can fly!
wings_remind: The isle north of town, above the tower road. Jump twice in the wind column to glide!
wings_done: You flew! I watched you from the fountain. You were like a falling star going the wrong way!
Take this crystal. It holds a heartbeat of the old star. It'll make you stronger.
starspire_offer: Now for the real journey. The Starspire, the great isle with the pillar of light, is where the star fell.
Nobody has stood on it since. If anyone can reach it, it's you. Follow the light to the north-east.
starspire_remind: The Starspire is the isle with the pillar of light. Find an updraft beneath it and climb the wind.
starspire_done: You stood on the Starspire... and it let you. Then the star chose you, I'm sure of it.
Here. The core of a fallen star. Tobin will want to see this one day.
mira_greet: Well, hello there, sleepyhead. Wren told me all about you.
I'm Mira. Herbs, teas, salves, and a little bit of star-magic when nobody's looking.
mira_idle: Apples from the meadow, mushrooms from the woods. The land still feeds us, even now.
A pinch of glowshard in the tea and you'll see in the dark for an hour. Probably.
Mind the woods at night. The things that walk there aren't looking for herbs.
shards_offer: Have you seen the Starshards? Little floating crystals, glowing blue. They're scattered everywhere since the star fell.
Find three of them. Each one you touch will make your breath last longer. And I'll brew you something special.
shards_remind: Starshards float above hilltops, isles and lonely corners. Three of them, love.
shards_done: Three shards! You're positively glowing. Literally, a little.
Here, a hearty stew and a flask of liquid light. Don't drink them at the same time.
tobin_greet: Ho there! Tobin's the name, hammers are the game.
That blade of yours is pretty, I'll give you that. But pretty doesn't stop a Rusted knight.
tobin_idle: A good hammer, a hot fire, and a cup of Mira's tea. That's all a smith needs.
Iron sings different since the star fell. Higher. Happier, almost.
Rocks out in the hills give up iron if you strike them true.
ore_offer: Tell you what. Bring me five chunks of iron ore and I'll forge you a sword worth swinging.
Strike the big rocks out past the town. Some of them hide iron in their hearts.
ore_remind: Five iron ore, friend. The grey boulders in the hills are your best bet.
ore_done: Now that's good iron. Stand back, this'll take a moment.
There! The Crystalline Sword. Forged in starfire and stubbornness. Take care of her.
aldous_greet: Hold, traveller. You carry yourself like a Lightwarden, and there have been none of us for thirty years.
I am Aldous. I guard this town as I once guarded the star. Badly, some would say.
aldous_idle: A blade is a promise. Keep it sharp, and keep it.
When the sun goes down, the dead walk the old roads. Stay near the lanterns.
My order sealed its secrets away when the star fell. One day I will find them again.
hunt_offer: The dark has been bold of late. The risen dead walk the roads by night, and the woods are no longer safe.
Prove your blade. Defeat six of them, and I will tell you of the thing that leads them.
hunt_remind: Six of the risen. Night brings them out in numbers. Strike first, dodge always.
hunt_done: Six! You fight like a storm. My old order would have been proud to call you sister.
Take these coins. Spend them on something that makes you smile.
warden_offer: Now hear me. Beyond the hills stands a ruin, and in it the Rusted Warden, once my brother in arms.
The dark wears him like armour now. Set him free. Your compass will show you the way.
warden_remind: The Rusted Warden waits in the ruins. Watch his great swings, and strike when he stumbles.
warden_done: So he is at peace at last. Thank you, Lightwarden. Yes, I will call you that now.
This blade was his, before the rust. The Jadewind Saber. It belongs to the one who freed him.
gloom_stone_offer: West of the Haven the trees close in and the light turns green and cold. The Gloomwood.
There is a Starstone in its heart, asleep. Wake it, and the herbs there might be gathered safely again.
gloom_stone_remind: The Gloomwood lies west. Look for the pale obelisk with the crystal floating above it.
gloom_stone_done: You woke it! I could feel the woods breathe easier from here.
Take these flasks. The Gloomwood is dark even at noon.
gloom_cull_offer: The stone is awake, but the thornlings still choke the paths, and the wisp-callers lure travellers off them.
Cut down eight of them. Mind the thornlings: they lunge when they crouch.
gloom_cull_remind: Eight of the Gloomwood's creatures. The thornlings crouch before they charge. Step aside when they do.
gloom_cull_done: The paths are clear. I can gather moonmoss again.
These emeralds grew in the roots of the old trees. And a heart crystal, for your courage.
frost_stone_offer: You fought well in the Gloomwood. Now I ask something harder.
The Frostpeaks rise north and west. The Lightwardens kept a watch there once, beside a Starstone. Wake it.
frost_stone_remind: The Frostpeaks. Dress warm, and keep your blade dry. The Starstone stands among the snows.
frost_stone_done: The old watch burns again. My brothers would weep to see it.
Eat. Snow takes more from a body than any blade.
frost_cull_offer: Frost knights hold the passes. Once they were men of my order, frozen in their oath.
Grant them rest. Eight of them, knights or shades.
frost_cull_remind: The frost knights swing slow but hard. Their ground cracks before the blow lands. Watch for it.
frost_cull_done: They rest now. Thank you, sister.
This luckstone was our captain's. It is yours by right.
sun_stone_offer: My caravans run through the Sunscar for copper and glass. Or did, until the raiders came.
Wake the Starstone out in the red sands. Once it shines, my drivers will have a light to steer by.
sun_stone_remind: The Sunscar's south and west, past the dunes. When the sand blows, find shelter and wait it out.
sun_stone_done: They saw it from the road! A star in the desert!
Here, iron for whatever you mean to forge. And coin, of course.
sun_cull_offer: Now the raiders. Ten of them, the dune raiders and the ones who hurl sand in your eyes.
Do that and the road is open again.
sun_cull_remind: The throwers keep their distance. Close in fast. The raiders will come to you.
sun_cull_done: The road is open! My first caravan in a month came in this morning.
Rubies from the south, and a lumen core. Don't ask what I paid for it.
ash_stone_offer: The Ashlands. Where the mountains bleed fire.
Something marches out of those craters. Before we fight it, we need a light there. Wake the Starstone.
ash_stone_remind: Do not walk on the lava, whatever you do. The Starstone stands on cool ground between the cones.
ash_stone_done: You walked through fire and came back. I have known knights who could not.
Take this. And the coin; you have earned a thousand times more.
ash_cull_offer: Cinder knights and ember-callers march from the craters. Ten of them must fall.
The callers throw fire from afar. The knights slam the ground. Never stand where it glows.
ash_cull_remind: Ten of the cinder host. Strike the callers first; they will burn you from behind.
ash_cull_done: This blade was forged from star-iron for the last Lightwarden. I think she has finally been found.
blight_stone_offer: There is one place left. The Blight. Where the star fell, and the dark came up through the hole it left.
Wake its Starstone. If anything can push the dark back, it is starlight.
blight_stone_remind: The Blight is east of the Haven, under the violet sky. Be careful. Please.
blight_stone_done: I saw the light from the harbour wall. The whole sky over the Blight went silver for a moment.
Here. A lumen core, and every coin the Haven could spare.
blight_cull_offer: The shades still pour out of the Blight's heart. Twelve of them, and the callers who summon them.
After that, I think the Starfall can finally sleep.
blight_cull_remind: Twelve shades. They flicker when they strike. Watch for the violet glow under them.
blight_cull_done: It's quiet. Truly quiet. For the first time since the star fell.
The Tidecaller relic, and a heart crystal. You are the Haven's light now.
